title: Prism
summary: A pair of Jupyter notebooks that generate synthetic tabular data from a Hadoop network-element CSV dataset using GAN-based synthesizers. The core workflow builds an sdv.metadata.SingleTableMetadata object and fits sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer on the data, running SDV's CTGAN synthesizer directly to produce synthetic records.
